blocked.reason: no per-stage median dwell column exists on the opportunity board in this checkout, and no scenario observes one. There is no authority to cite, and pointing at the board's source file would only prove the file has these bytes

the opportunity record carries no manifest revision in this application at all: app inspect reports it as a core record, not an ADR-019 managed module, so a bounded stall-reason field cannot be added at a new revision here. The plan's premise about this record does not hold in this composition

evidence.expects: the journey completes and reports success

partial.reason: the journey composes the starter into a temporary directory of its own and drives it. It is not evidence that a person installing the starter into their own empty project gets the same result, because nothing here installs into a project a person owns

evidence.describes: a person opens the opportunity board in a browser and reads whether the data-quality caveat is rendered beside the dwell column. No browser is driven anywhere in this repository, so nothing automated can answer it

blocked.reason: the record is present and carries no manifest revision, so there is no module-factory state file to check in and no revision bump to apply. This requirement is blocked on the record becoming an ADR-019 managed module, which is work no evidence document can substitute for

limitations.message: this plan is bound to the repository root, which composes no domain package, and every shipped scenario composes a starter into a directory of its own. So the scenario observations cited for the starter-installation criterion were observed in a different application than this plan was written against, and they are refused as EVIDENCE_COMPOSITION_MISMATCH rather than counted. The citations are kept so the gap is machine-visible instead of quietly absent: nothing in this repository can currently give this plan a behavioural authority

this plan describes work that has not been done. Four of its six requirements are blocked or manual, and the two that verify are the ones about the repository the plan was written in rather than about the change it proposes. A green line here would be the defect
